redfin.remarks: Discover a unique blend of historic charm and modern sophistication at the iconic Livingstone Hotel in the heart of Pasadena. Originally built in 1927 and beautifully reconstructed in 2010, this distinctive residence combines timeless architectural character with contemporary finishes and urban convenience. This inviting one-bedroom, one-bathroom home features soaring ceilings, exposed historic brick walls, expansive windows that fill the space with natural light, and polished concrete floors that create a stylish, loft-inspired atmosphere. The open-concept living and dining areas flow seamlessly into a custom Italian kitchen featuring granite countertops , stainless steel appliances, soft-close cabinetry, and thoughtfully designed finishes. French doors from the main living area open to a generous 75-square-foot covered patio with charming brick and concrete details, overlooking a landscaped, park-like setting. This inviting outdoor retreat is ideal for morning coffee, alfresco dining, or relaxing after a long day. Additional highlights include a beautifully finished bathroom with custom tilework and the convenience of in-unit laundry. Perfectly positioned in one of Pasadena's most desirable urban locations, just moments from Old Town Pasadena, The Paseo, the Pasadena Playhouse District, Lake Avenue, and an incredible selection of restaurants, cafés, shopping, and entertainment. Experience the character of a historic landmark with the comfort of modern living, all in an exceptional Pasadena location.
